title: candidate_lineage v1
description: The version index for a single inversion candidate. Lives at data/candidates/{candidate_id}/lineage.json. Lists all versions ever computed for this candidate (active, deprecated, and split-parent), names the active one, and back-links to a parent candidate when this candidate was created by a split. Boundaries, K, locked_labels are NOT in here — those live per-version under data/candidates/{candidate_id}/{version_id}/. This file is the index, not the data.

candidate_id.description: Stable lineage ID for this candidate. Timestamp-based, never changes (a refinement creates a new version inside this candidate; a split creates new candidates with new ids).

active_version_id.description: Which version_id is currently the canonical view. Pages and analysis modules default to this when no explicit version is requested. Changing this rewrites lineage.json but does not touch any per-version subfolder.

status.description: Top-level lifecycle of the candidate. 'active' = current normal state. 'split' = this candidate was decomposed into multiple new candidates; see split_into. 'merged_into' = this candidate was absorbed into another; see merged_into_candidate_id. 'abandoned' = no longer pursued (e.g. shown to be artifact).

parent_candidate_id.description: If this candidate was born from a split or other restructuring of an earlier candidate, the candidate_id of that parent. null otherwise.

split_into.description: When status='split', the candidate_ids of the children. Empty otherwise.

merged_into_candidate_id.description: When status='merged_into', the candidate_id this was merged into. null otherwise.

versions.description: Map of version_id -> version metadata. At least one version must exist (the version_id named in active_version_id).

version_id.description: Unique within this candidate. Convention: 'v<n>_<method>_<note>', e.g. 'v1_localPCA_initial', 'v2_theta_refined', 'v3_manual'. Must match the parent map key.

parent_version_id.description: Which version this one was derived from. null for the original v1.

source_methods.description: Methods that contributed to this version's boundaries / labels. Examples: 'localPCA', 'thetaPi', 'shelfLD', 'manual_review', 'breakpoint_dosage', 'arrangement_consensus'.

callset_id.description: Identifier of the karyotype callset associated with this version. Used by analysis modules to fetch the right per-sample assignments. null if not yet called.

status.description: Per-version status. Exactly one version per candidate should have status='active' and that version_id must equal candidate_lineage.active_version_id. 'deprecated' = older versions kept for audit trail; readable but not the default. 'experimental' = work in progress, not yet promoted to active.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this version was first written.

created_by.description: User identifier or process name that wrote this version. e.g. 'qa', 'auto_thetapi_refinement_v1', 'pipeline_localPCA_K3_v1'. Free-form, not enforced.

dependency_hash.description: Hash of the inputs that determined this version (parent boundaries, dosage version, callset config). Used to detect when a re-run with different inputs would produce a different result. Not enforced by the engine; producers compute and store it.

notes.description: Free-form human-readable notes for this version: what changed vs the parent, why it was created, known caveats.

v1_localPCA_initial.notes: Initial localPCA K=3 call from chrom-wide scrubber

v2_theta_refined.notes: Theta-pi refined; narrowed to high-Fst shelf 15.115-18.005 Mb
